args.text: NEON MAXIMALIST — a Spotube v4 theme

children.text: Ctrl/Cmd+B folds the control panel. The marquee above the page carries the record and a light that only burns while the transport runs. The coin rail under it holds your pinned lists.
TYPE TO LIGHT UP THE VAULT
Hardware dip switches, CRT calibrations, audio filters and palette registers. Persists across cabinet reboots.
